meta.title: Go D — Your Ride. Your Price. Your Way.
meta.description: Go D is Riyadh's premium ride-hailing app. Your ride, your price, your way.

hero.tagline: Your Ride. Your Price. Your Way.
hero.copy: A smarter way to move through Riyadh. Choose your route, set your fare, and ride with confidence.

howItWorks.title: From where you are to where you want to be.
howItWorks.intro: Three simple steps put you in control of every journey.

step1.title: Set your pickup & destination
step1.copy: Tell Go D where the journey starts and where you are heading.

step2.title: Choose fixed price or bid
step2.copy: Accept the suggested fare or propose a price that works for you.

step3.title: Your verified driver arrives
step3.copy: Choose with confidence, track the arrival, and enjoy your ride.

features.title: Built for the way Riyadh moves.
features.intro: Local-first technology, flexible fares, and safety designed into every tap.

card1.title: Nafath Verified
card1.copy: Driver identities verified through Saudi Arabia's national system.

card2.title: Bid Your Price
card2.copy: Propose your fare and compare offers from nearby drivers.

card3.title: Women-Only Mode
card3.copy: Female riders can choose to match with female drivers only.

card4.title: Real-Time Tracking
card4.copy: Watch your driver arrive and share live journey details.

card5.title: All Payment Methods
card5.copy: Mada, Visa, Apple Pay, STC Pay, or cash—the choice is yours.

card6.title: 24/7 Safety
card6.copy: SOS access, masked calls, and responsive support throughout the ride.

driver.title: Drive with Go D. Earn more. Keep more.
driver.copy: Build your schedule around your life and join a platform designed to value every driver.

download.title: Riyadh's next ride is already on its way.
download.copy: Get ready for flexible fares, verified drivers, and a ride built around you.
download.scan: Scan to join the launch list

safety.title: Confidence should come standard.
safety.copy: Go D is being designed around Saudi requirements, verified identities, secure payments, and clear support paths.

footer.about: Your ride. Your price. Your way. A new mobility experience, made for Riyadh.
